en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. Last stanza mixes eastern/other dialect forms (оду, све, сас, зему, векују); my reading for lines 2 and 3 of it is loose.

lines.en: Little girl, my soul, your face
You just walk past my gate,

lines.cyr: кој замине моме и те види,
lines.lat: koj zamine mome i te vidi,
lines.en: whoever passes, girl, and sees you,

lines.cyr: сал' застане душо и се чуди.
lines.lat: sal' zastane dušo i se čudi.
lines.en: only stops, my soul, and marvels.
Should he continue on his way,
Thinking of it he freezes there

lines.cyr: и у јутро сам си осамнува.
lines.lat: i u jutro sam si osamnuva.

lines.cyr: Куде оду моме све си мислу,
lines.lat: Kude odu mome sve si mislu,
lines.en: Where I go, girl, I think of everything,

lines.cyr: кад га свију полноќ све сонују,
lines.lat: kad ga sviju polnoḱ sve sonuju,
lines.en: when midnight bends all, they dream of it,

lines.cyr: како тебе моме да те зему,
lines.lat: kako tebe mome da te zemu,

lines.cyr: и сас тебе век да си векују.
lines.lat: i sas tebe vek da si vekuju.
